tagline: Coated steel. Roofing systems. Lightweight construction.
eyebrow: Metal roofing, light steel and building systems since 1994

story.title: A roofing problem became a building-system business.
story.body: Founded in 1994, Tatalogam positions itself as a pioneer of coated steel roofing and lightweight construction systems in Indonesia. The current ecosystem spans metal roof tiles, light steel, floor decks, large-span structures, accessories, apps and an authorized reseller network.

highlights.title: Metal roof leadership
highlights.body: Metal tiles and roofing are positioned around corrosion resistance, weather durability and lighter structures.

highlights.title: Light steel ecosystem
highlights.body: TASO and related systems extend the offer into structural framing, warehouses and smart housing.

highlights.title: Standards + patents
highlights.body: The company highlights ISO 9001, relevant ASTM/AISC standards and Indonesian roofing patents.

highlights.title: Authorized reseller network
highlights.body: A broad official reseller list makes product authenticity and local availability part of the customer journey.

gallery.label: TASO lightweight steel
gallery.caption: Structural framing designed around strength, consistency and corrosion resistance.

gallery.label: Multi Roof
gallery.caption: Metal roofing that combines lightweight construction with residential aesthetics.
